purpose: Teach: 沈ん/終っ/有っ/盗ん/図ら/造ら/生かさ/臨ん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、机に沈んでうとうとしてたな
lines.en: You were totally zonked out at your desk just now.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Quick pace, slight smile in the voice. The tone of someone calling out a friend's obvious tiredness without making it mean.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、試験が終ったら遊ぼうぜ、桜
lines.en: Once the exam's done, let's hang out, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm invitation, a little hopeful underneath. Soft attack on the opening word. Steady, genuine tone — not performing, actually wanting this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、自転車が有って便利だな
lines.en: Your place is pretty convenient with that bike there.
lines.style: Offhand observation with a thread of curiosity. Lighter tone, testing the waters. Not quite a question, more like she's thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、消しゴム盗んだだろ、桜
lines.en: You definitely stole my eraser, didn't you?
lines.style: Dry, mock-accusatory. Fast delivery on the question. Half amused, half genuinely suspicious. The rhythm of someone calling a friend out over a small familiar crime.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭の予算を図らないとな
lines.en: We need to nail down the budget for the culture festival.
lines.style: Businesslike but not cold. Straightforward and clear, like she's just stated a fact everyone knows. Slight lift at the end — delegating, not demanding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、模型を造らせるの上手だな、桜
lines.en: You're actually really good at getting people to make those models.
lines.style: Genuine compliment delivered casually. Softer tone than her usual. A beat of real recognition — not effusive, just sincere acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、勉強時間を生かさないと留年だぞ
lines.en: You have to use your study time better or you'll actually get held back.
lines.style: Direct concern masked as practical advice. Steady, no-nonsense tone. A little firmer than her usual teasing — this matters and she wants him to hear it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、大会に臨んで頑張ったな、桜
lines.en: You really stepped up for that competition.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Slower pace on this one. Close proximity in the voice, like she's saying something that costs her a little. Real respect showing through.
